text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――One day in December.
While logging today's recorded times on the tablet,
I check our progress toward the next race.
choice_data_list: (Come to think of it, the Arima Kinen is coming up soon.)
(Come to think of it, the Arima Kinen is coming up soon.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...What is the matter?
Is there an issue with the upcoming schedule...?
choice_data_list: No, I was just thinking that the Arima Kinen is coming up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Based on the fan vote results, it wasn't impossible
for Chrono Genesis to enter the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, due to conditioning issues and timing,
it seemed difficult to enter in top condition,
so we had decided to skip the race this year."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Ah!
Th-this time... I'm planning to go watch as a spectator!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
What happened at the Takarazuka Kinen
won't happen again... So, p-please don't worry!
choice_data_list: Then do you want to go together? To the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ! I... I'll go! P-Please... by all means, let me join you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In late December, we'll be watching the Arima Kinen.
Let's make sure not to schedule any races then.
